review_description: Very quick turn around on the quote, Brad was fast to come back to me with answers to my questions and they provided a firm price without even needing a site visit (just a few photos via SMS). We agreed on the make and model and booked install for just over a week away. Future services quote came in far cheaper than the price of another plumber we were talking to, and they had their own electrician do the circuit where as the other guys quote didn't include this part of the job. The day of the install it was absolutely bucketing with rain but Dane and Aaron worked tirelessly anyway and competed a fantastic job even in the soaking conditions. Highly professional and very high quality with the final install. We couldn't be happier with the job done by future services. 10/10.

Great experience with Future Services buying and getting our heat pump installed - very professional and nice people and fair price. Keenan and team were always happy to answer my questions about the new installation and changeover from our old continuous gas system. They arrived as scheduled, were unfailingly polite, and did an excellent job. Really happy, thanks.

Asked for a quote on SolarQuotes, Keenan, the owner, called himself, came by to look at the situation around my house. After we selected the heat pump, he had to call around to find one as they were all sold out, did find one and the next Friday the guys installed it, disconnected and removed the gas installation and placed the heat pump so that we could still access the small area behind the house (the houses here are very close together, with like 90cm between wall and fence)

Future Services team are very professional and knowledgeable and provided a competitive price using high quality inverter, panels and battery.Installers did a great job, neat, tidy and working wellWell done from start to finish, all connected for us
Quoting process was simple to understandInstallation ran smoothlyCustomer service was prompt and professional at all times

Future were a great company to deal with from start to finish, Keenan the owner actually came to my house and ran through the proposal with me and he was very professional and didn't sound like a salesman like the other companies did. Definitely recommend these guys.

The team from Future Services were a pleasure to deal with from start to finish. Their product knowledge, attention to detail and quality service really made the whole process a breeze!Installation was completed in a timely manner and the technicians were polite and left our place neat and tidy.Would highly recommended the team to anyone looking into installing a new solar system.
